reliability_notes: Official state-level cuisine overview; ingredients and dishes are Rajasthan-general, not proof of Marwari household practice.
title: Cuisine of Rajasthan

publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan
reliability_notes: Statewide tourism overview; claims are Rajasthan-general and must not be narrowed to Marwar without local corroboration.
title: Customs and Rituals

publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan
reliability_notes: Official tourism travel diary about the Marwar Festival; clothing and performance descriptions are festival-context observations, not universal daily dress.
title: Discovering an All New Side of the Heritage of Jodhpur

reliability_notes: Official state foundation overview; regional statements are limited to what the page explicitly enumerates.

publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan
reliability_notes: Official destination page. Useful for named Jodhpur sites and visitor descriptions; not a comprehensive ethnography.
title: Jodhpur

reliability_notes: Official language and culture overview; it names Marwari among Rajasthani varieties but does not provide phrase-level dialect evidence.
title: Rajasthani Language

publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan
reliability_notes: Official shopping/craft guide. It names Jodhpur and Salawas for particular textiles and crafts; it does not establish household prevalence.
title: Shopping in Rajasthan

reliability_notes: Museum catalogue describing objects and historical/court contexts, including early-20th-century paags and royal garments. Good evidence for catalogued objects and the interpretations presented by the museum; not an ethnographic survey of contemporary rural everyday dress.
title: Textiles

publisher: Asian Journal of Home Science; Hind Institute of Science and Technology
reliability_notes: Two-page 2008 research note reporting a 2005–2006 survey of Sindhi-Sepahi Musalman Rajput families in 168 Jodhpur-district villages. Useful for its named sample and reported garments; narrow to that community, survey period and setting. Do not generalize to other communities or present-day individuals.
title: Traditional Costumes of Musalman Rajput Community in Western Rajasthan, India
